note: The monitor universe lives in backend/momentum_universe.py (generic futures, yields, curves, DXY and the SG Trend Index NEIXCTAT Index). Generic futures are fetched ratio back-adjusted ('TY1 R:00_0_R Comdty'). The Single Series view also accepts any user-supplied ticker or expression. Probe with scripts/probe_momentum.py.

series.description: Any Bloomberg ticker or weighted expression entered at runtime, e.g. 'RX1 Comdty', 'USGG10YR Index - USGG2YR Index'. Needs 360 days of history.
